title: Exotic Floral Middle Eastern Wheat Bread Harees
description: A low-fat, fluffy, and flavorful Middle Eastern dish featuring grilled bread and floral notes, perfect for a monsoon evening.
instructions: Preheat a cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Cut the whole wheat bread into 1-inch cubes and toast until lightly browned.
In a large bowl, whisk together rose water, orange blossom water, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the toasted bread cubes to the bowl and toss until the bread is evenly coated with the floral mixture.
Transfer the bread mixture to the preheated cast-iron skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in dried rose petals and chopped fresh parsley.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the bread is crispy and golden brown.
Remove from heat and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with additional parsley and rose petals if desired.
